name: LUFest
author: L'Cronx
summary: Loudness meter for the master channel's effects: momentary, short-term and integrated LUFS, LRA, 4x oversampled true peak, held L/R sample peaks, green/yellow/red level bars with a CLIP lamp, and large readouts. Audio passes through untouched. Tested on an Akai Force; numbers not yet checked against a reference meter. MPC OS 3.x.
